assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single transparent PNG workspace icon for an intranet directory, displayed at 24–28 CSS pixels.
Primary request: a satisfying chunky minimal folder/workspace icon, subtly 3D, with a little SharePoint-like S.
Subject: one rounded teal folder with an offset folder tab at its upper left, a thick softly bevelled front face and just a little depth visible along the top and right. A small integrated darker teal rounded-square badge overlaps the lower-right front face, with one crisp white uppercase S.
Style: restrained premium UI icon, smooth matte moulded material, soft bevels, very simple silhouette, near-frontal view with extremely subtle perspective. Light teal upper edges, deeper teal side edge; gentle self-shadow only.
Composition: square canvas, icon centred, occupy about 88% of the canvas width and height, leave equal narrow safe margins; no cropping. Designed to remain clear and distinctive at 24px.
Text (verbatim): "S" only, bold simple sans-serif.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background; no floor or backdrop, no floating shadow outside the object, no border or app-tile container, no additional symbols, no words, no lock, no watermark. Make the S readable at tiny UI scale. Deliver just the one isolated icon.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: matching restricted-access PNG icon for a website, displayed at 24–28 CSS pixels.
Input image: the attached teal folder is the exact base design.
Primary request: make the restricted version of this same chunky, minimal, subtly 3D folder. Keep its folder silhouette, proportions, near-frontal view, soft bevels, and small lower-right S badge. Replace the filled teal folder with a thick muted crimson / berry-red OUTLINE version: clear red bevelled rim around the folder shape, with a very pale blush, nearly white recessed centre, much lighter than the red outline. The S badge is deep red with a crisp white uppercase S.
Add a clearly recognisable compact chunky closed padlock, overlapping the folder's upper-right edge, visibly in front of it. The red padlock has a simple rounded rectangular body and rounded shackle. Make the lock large enough to recognise at tiny size (about one third of the folder height), with simple clean geometry and no fine detail.
Composition: one isolated combined folder-and-lock icon, square canvas, all edges inside frame, narrow equal safe margins; same visual scale as the supplied icon. Keep S visible and unobscured.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background outside the icon; no backdrop, no floor, no extra text, no app tile container, no additional elements or watermark. The only text is "S". This must look like a red outline sibling of the teal folder, not a solid red folder. Maintain a minimal satisfying moulded UI icon look.
